claim_boundary: This catalog records discovered sources and interface facts. Only entries with production_eligible=true may be selected automatically; catalog inclusion is not scientific endorsement.

georoc-archaean.title: GEOROC Compilation: Archaean Cratons

coverage.notes: Global distribution of Archaean cratons only; not representative of all rock geochemistry.

license.notes: Retain GEOROC and original publication citations.

limitations: Precompiled selected values are not an unfiltered set of every replicate determination.

usgs-conus-soil.title: Geochemical and mineralogical data for soils of the conterminous United States

coverage.notes: Three sampled soil layers in CONUS; not global soil coverage.

license.notes: USGS-produced data are public domain; credit and dataset citation are retained.

limitations: Soil layers and legacy qualifier encodings must remain distinct.

georoc-database.title: GEOROC Database

coverage.notes: Published igneous and metamorphic rocks, glasses, minerals and inclusions; coverage follows available literature.

license.notes: Database query data require GEOROC and original source citation; repository datasets may have separate terms.

limitations: Only a test API endpoint has been documented in this discovery round; production endpoint and response version must be verified.
Aggregated records must retain every original publication reference.

usgs-ngdb.title: U.S. Geological Survey National Geochemical Database

coverage.notes: Primarily inorganic elemental concentrations for US and Alaska geologic samples.

license.notes: Individual releases and non-USGS contributions still require dataset-level review.

limitations: Historical databases contain heterogeneous methods, qualifiers and reporting units.
A specific immutable data release must be selected before production use.

gemstat-open-archive.title: GEMStat Global Freshwater Quality Database open archive
gemstat-open-archive.publisher: UNEP GEMS/Water Programme and International Centre for Water Resources and Global Change

coverage.notes: Ground and surface water observations voluntarily provided by participating countries; spatial and temporal coverage is uneven.

license.notes: Only batches explicitly released as CC BY 4.0 or equivalent may enter open production outputs.

limitations: Provider-specific access policies must be preserved.
Portal requests are limited and must not be automated around contact or station restrictions.
A concrete Zenodo version, file inventory and checksum set must be pinned.

wosis.title: World Soil Information Service (WoSIS)

coverage.notes: Quality-assessed and standardised soil profile data shared by many providers; coverage and property availability vary.

license.notes: Public records can include CC BY and CC BY-NC; license must be retained and filtered at record level.

limitations: WoSIS contains standardised soil properties, not a single uniform total-element geochemistry program.
Dynamic WFS and immutable DOI snapshot are separate acquisition modes.
Non-commercial license records are not eligible under open-only production policy.

earthchem-portal.title: EarthChem Portal

coverage.notes: Federated discovery across participating solid-earth geochemistry databases.

license.notes: Retain the original database, dataset and publication terms for every record.

limitations: Aggregator results are discovery leads, not independent corroborating sources.
Production records must resolve to an upstream database or DOI dataset.

gemas-europe.title: Geochemical Mapping of Agricultural and Grazing Land Soil (GEMAS)

coverage.notes: Harmonised agricultural and grazing land soil survey for Europe.

license.notes: Numeric data redistribution and dataset-level license require verification.

limitations: Current discovery evidence identifies map services and project links but not a verified open bulk numeric release.

petdb.title: PetDB EarthChem Data Synthesis

coverage.notes: Published igneous and metamorphic rock, glass, inclusion and mineral chemistry, concentrated on ocean-floor and mantle settings.

license.notes: Site license is CC BY-SA 4.0; every record must also retain its original publication and contributing-dataset citation.

limitations: Dynamic holdings require a query timestamp, exported record inventory and upstream-reference deduplication.
Database aggregation is not independent corroboration of GEOROC or original publications.

foregs-europe.title: FOREGS-EuroGeoSurveys Geochemical Atlas of Europe baseline data
foregs-europe.publisher: EuroGeoSurveys and Geological Survey of Finland

coverage.notes: Harmonised low-density European baseline survey of topsoil, subsoil, humus, stream/floodplain sediment and stream water.

license.notes: Pages state that the database is freely downloadable and prescribe atlas citation/copyright; machine-readable redistribution terms still need legal review.

limitations: Very low continental sampling density is not local coverage.
Multiple techniques and laboratories must remain explicit even though sampling was harmonised.

canada-cdogs.title: Canadian Database of Geochemical Surveys (CDoGS)
canada-cdogs.publisher: Natural Resources Canada, Geological Survey of Canada

coverage.notes: Catalogue of more than 1,300 Canadian regional geochemical surveys; standardized raw downloads are available for a subset.

license.notes: Federal and provincial releases can use different Open Government licences; pin and retain the licence of each selected release.

limitations: Only a subset of catalogued surveys currently has standardized raw downloads.
Reanalysis and republication histories can create related records that must not be counted as independent samples.

australia-ngsa.title: National Geochemical Survey of Australia
australia-ngsa.publisher: Geoscience Australia and Australian state/territory geological surveys

coverage.notes: Ultra-low-density catchment-outlet transported regolith survey covering more than 90 percent of Australia; useful nationally, not locally.

license.notes: Geoscience Australia material is generally CC BY 4.0, but each selected data product must be checked for third-party exceptions.

limitations: Catchment-outlet transported regolith is not interchangeable with in-situ topsoil or stream sediment.
The sampling density is designed for national-scale patterns, not site-scale prediction.

australia-ozchem.title: OZCHEM National Whole Rock and Stream Sediment Geochemistry Database

coverage.notes: National compilation of located whole-rock and stream-sediment analyses from Geoscience Australia and other surveys.

license.notes: Current product-specific licensing and any contributed state data exceptions need confirmation.

limitations: Discovery located official legacy documentation but not a verified current bulk numeric endpoint.
Contributed state-survey records may overlap upstream releases.

us-water-quality-portal.title: Water Quality Portal
us-water-quality-portal.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey, U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and National Water Quality Monitoring Council

coverage.notes: Programmatic access to WQX and NWIS water-quality records from many organizations and sample media.

license.notes: Federal records may be public domain, but WQX contains many contributor organizations; retain provider and dataset terms per record.

limitations: Portal aggregation is not an independent source from NWIS or WQX providers.
Characteristic names, sample fractions, detection limits, qualifiers and organization methods are highly heterogeneous.

soils4africa.title: Soils4Africa soil point data

coverage.notes: Harmonised 2022-2024 point observations and laboratory chemical properties across sampled African agricultural land.

license.notes: CC BY 4.0 use is accompanied by anti-identification and reporting/aggregation conditions that must be implemented before production.

limitations: The licence warns that points are not representative of local or field conditions.
The exact elemental analyte inventory and privacy-safe output policy require audit before routing.

bgs-gbase.title: Geochemical Baseline Survey of the Environment (G-BASE)

coverage.notes: Long-running baseline survey of soil, stream sediment, stream water and panned concentrates across the UK.

license.notes: Derived grids are OGL; underpinning survey point observations require a separate BGS licence and are not open-only production data.

limitations: Open interpolated grids are derived products and cannot substitute for source point observations.
Point data cannot enter the open-only production route without a compatible explicit licence.

brazil-sgb-geochemistry.title: GeoSGB integrated geochemical samples

coverage.notes: National geochemical sample service and project releases spanning several sample media and survey periods.

license.notes: Open access is stated for repository items, but reuse/redistribution terms for the integrated service need verification.

limitations: Integrated points and project ZIP releases may duplicate each other.
Field definitions, sample-medium codes, analytical methods and licence need source-level verification.

nz-petlab.title: Petlab: New Zealand national rock, mineral and geoanalytical database

coverage.notes: National curated sample and analytical database with contributed university collections and selected offshore/global material.

license.notes: A free account is required for export; download and redistribution terms need review.

limitations: Dynamic database version and export inventory must be recorded for reproducibility.
Published, thesis and collection data require original-reference retention and duplicate review.

earthchem-library.title: EarthChem Library

coverage.notes: Curated DOI repository for contributed Earth and planetary science datasets; each deposited dataset has its own scope and licence.

license.notes: Depositors choose among CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA and non-commercial Creative Commons licences; filter at dataset level.

limitations: Repository inclusion is not uniform geochemical coverage or method comparability.
Each DOI dataset must pass its own licence, schema, hash, citation and duplicate checks before use.

geotraces-idp2025.title: GEOTRACES Intermediate Data Product 2025
geotraces-idp2025.publisher: GEOTRACES International Project Office and NERC EDS British Oceanographic Data Centre

coverage.notes: Quality-controlled trace-element, isotope and hydrographic data from 123 cruises and 4,097 stations across all ocean basins.

license.notes: Fair Use Agreement requires IDP and original data-contributor citations.

limitations: Cruise-track ocean sampling is not uniform global surface-water coverage.
Dissolved, particulate and other fractions plus quality flags and contributor citations must remain distinct.
The official archive was still being prepared during the 2026-08-05 verification, so the member inventory, hashes and variable-level mapping remain unverified.

glorich.title: GLORICH Global River Chemistry Database
glorich.publisher: PANGAEA Data Publisher for Earth & Environmental Science

coverage.notes: Compilation of more than 1.27 million samples from more than 18,000 river sampling locations, focused on major compounds, nutrients and carbon.

license.notes: Non-commercial restriction excludes this dataset from the current open-only production route.

limitations: Compilation inherits heterogeneous source methods and possible overlap with national/international portals.
Focus is major compounds and nutrients rather than comprehensive trace-element coverage.

eea-waterbase.title: Waterbase water quality data

coverage.notes: European reporting database for rivers, lakes, groundwater, transitional, coastal and marine waters, including chemical-quality observations.

license.notes: EEA permits commercial and non-commercial reuse with attribution, subject to dataset-specific third-party notices; exact machine-readable licence needs pinning.

limitations: National reporting coverage, determinands and methods vary by country and year.
Water, sediment and biota results must be separated by matrix and fraction.

noaa-ncei-marine-geology.title: NCEI Marine Geology Data Archive and IMLGS
noaa-ncei-marine-geology.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information

coverage.notes: Long-term heterogeneous archive of marine and lacustrine rock and sediment analyses, descriptions, images and sample metadata from many contributing programs.

license.notes: NOAA requests citation of the original source and DOI where provided; each archived numerical dataset must retain its own source and reuse terms.

limitations: IMLGS is primarily a sample inventory and cannot be treated as a table of geochemical measurements.
Archive files are heterogeneous and must be accepted, versioned and cited at the original dataset level.

pangaea-repository.title: PANGAEA Data Publisher for Earth & Environmental Science
pangaea-repository.publisher: Alfred Wegener Institute and MARUM, University of Bremen

coverage.notes: Open-access repository for georeferenced observational and experimental Earth-system datasets, including many publication-linked geochemical datasets.

license.notes: The licence is stated on each dataset; recent defaults do not replace dataset-level checks for historical, moratorium or community-specific records.

limitations: Repository search results are not one harmonised geochemical dataset.
Every DOI must pass separate media, method, licence, file, checksum, citation and duplicate checks.

iodp-data-systems.title: IODP, ODP and DSDP expedition data systems
iodp-data-systems.publisher: International Ocean Discovery Program and its Science Operators

coverage.notes: Expedition data include core and borehole rock or sediment measurements plus chemistry such as interstitial-water observations; coverage follows scientific drilling sites.

license.notes: Data access, moratorium status, citations and policies vary by program, science operator, expedition and derived publication.

limitations: Legacy and current data are fragmented across multiple operator systems and schemas.
Pore-water, solid-core and downhole records must remain separate and retain expedition, hole, depth and method context.

emodnet-chemistry.title: EMODnet Chemistry
emodnet-chemistry.publisher: European Marine Observation and Data Network Chemistry partnership

coverage.notes: Marine water and sediment chemistry from European data centres, with discovery records and regularly compiled harmonised data products.

license.notes: CDI records include both freely downloadable and restricted data; harmonised ERDDAP collections are compiled from unrestricted measurements but still require originator lineage.

limitations: The portal and derived collections can repeat data available from national providers, SeaDataNet or EEA systems.
Water, sediment and biota plus dissolved, particulate and total fractions must be separated before use.

jamstec-darwin.title: JAMSTEC DARWIN cruise data and sample information system
jamstec-darwin.publisher: Japan Agency for Marine-Earth Science and Technology

coverage.notes: Cruise, dive and sample discovery for JAMSTEC research vessels and submersibles, including rock and sediment-core sample catalogues.

license.notes: Cruise policy, moratorium, citation and data-quality class vary by record; commercial use requires advance application.

limitations: The current official pages verify sample and observation discovery, not a uniform numerical geochemistry endpoint.
Legacy GANSEKI references are not counted as a separate active source until their current data lineage is resolved.
Commercial use requires advance application, so DARWIN remains outside the open-only automatic route.

ireland-tellus.title: Geological Survey Ireland Tellus geochemistry data

coverage.notes: Tellus releases include multi-element shallow and deeper soil, stream-sediment and stream-water geochemistry with methods and release documentation.

license.notes: The official open-data policy and exact licence notice on each downloadable release must be pinned together.

limitations: Tellus releases and legacy national or regional surveys must be versioned and deduplicated separately.
The main GSI website was temporarily offline during this review, so exact files and licence notices need a fresh endpoint check before admission.

sweden-sgu-geochemical-atlas.title: Geochemical Atlas of Sweden data

coverage.notes: Downloadable national till geochemistry for the atlas; associated tables document methods, detection limits and comparisons with agricultural and grazing-land soil.

license.notes: The official data endpoint is public, but an exact reuse licence must be pinned before production.

limitations: The verified raw download is till data; summary tables for soil comparisons are not equivalent to raw soil observations.
Aqua-regia extraction, grain-size fraction, detection limits and sample medium must remain explicit.

finland-gtk-geochemistry.title: GTK national rock and regional geochemistry services

coverage.notes: National rock-geochemistry product plus till and stream-sediment layers exposed through GTK Hakku and ArcGIS services.

license.notes: The listed national rock product is free with an open licence, while other GTK products and detailed assay services may have separate terms or fees.

limitations: Rock, regional till, detailed till and stream-sediment layers are separate surveys and cannot share one method assumption.
Each selected layer or download must pin its licence, schema, sample count, method and service version.

norway-ngu-lito.title: LITO geochemical mapping of Norwegian bedrock

coverage.notes: Systematic national bedrock geochemistry sampled on an approximately 9 by 9 kilometre grid, with major, trace and rare-earth element methods.

license.notes: The spreadsheet is publicly downloadable, but its exact reuse licence and citation contract need to be pinned.

limitations: The June 2026 dataset is explicitly under development and has not completed final rock-name and batch-adjustment quality control.
A pinned version label is not sufficient for admission until file hash, licence, schema and QC flags are verified.

norway-marchem.title: MarChem marine chemistry database for Norwegian waters
norway-marchem.publisher: Institute of Marine Research and Geological Survey of Norway

coverage.notes: Contaminants and environmental characteristics measured in marine sediments from MAREANO and other Norwegian mapping and monitoring programs.

license.notes: The service states CC BY 4.0 and Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data; dataset landing-page citations and acknowledgements still apply.

limitations: The database contains natural elements and anthropogenic contaminants; target-analyte scope must be selected explicitly.
The verified public API export is dynamic and timestamped; the selected inorganic response has an observed project hash but no matching immutable DOI or publisher checksum yet.
The As, Cu, Ni and Zn measurements are reported on a dry-weight basis after partial nitric-acid digestion and must not be represented as total content.
Batch metadata mix accredited and not-accredited analyses, and the export can repeat a sample across parameter groups; both facts must survive record-level mapping.
